models_evaluated: custom weakly/semi-supervised deep learning model for lymph node metastasis detection

links.outcome: Model performance validated across independent data sets from three academic medical centers
links.effect: Combined test set of 165 positive and 622 negative cases: AUC 0.94 (95% CI 0.92-0.96), sensitivity 96%, specificity 92%.
links.quote: Validation was performed on independent data sets from 3 academic medical centers, comprising 787 whole slide images and >2000 lymph node tissues.

links.outcome: Micrometastasis miss rate and slide examination time of AI versus pathologists
links.effect: Pathologists had a 9% micrometastasis miss rate versus 3% for the AI model; the AI reduced slide examination time versus general and genitourinary pathologists (P < .001).
links.quote: Although pathologists exhibited a 9% miss rate in micrometastasis detection, the AI model demonstrated a significantly lower miss rate of 3% using the institutional data set, highlighting its potential for clinical deployment.

screen.reason: Evaluates an AI algorithm for histopathology detection of prostate cancer lymph node metastasis on multi-institutional retrospective datasets and compares detection performance and reading times against pathologists, but does not evaluate a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
